rows.input: color: blue; &:hover { color: green; } @nest :not(&) { color: red; }

original_expectation.label: basic
original_expectation.input: color: blue; &:hover { color: green; } @nest :not(&) { color: red; }

rationale: A raw style attribute/declaration list contains declarations, not nested style or conditional rules. Retain only the leading color:blue if present. Discard all nested blocks as non-declaration units; do not import enclosed green/red into the outer list. @nest is not required nesting syntax, and valid @media stylesheet grammar does not make an at-rule a declaration.

Static diagnostic trace: StrictDeclarationParser default QualifiedRuleParser rejects a non-identifier prelude with QualifiedRuleInvalid; default AtRuleParser rejects at-rules with AtRuleInvalid, mapped to UnknownAtRule for media/nest. Identifier-led div:hover first fails ordinary property resolution, and RuleBodyParser deliberately preserves that UnknownProperty when qualified fallback also fails. consume_failed_rule_block consumes each whole balanced curly body; spans exclude surrounding whitespace/semicolons unless the semicolon is part of the failed declaration unit.

rationale: foo lacks required colon and is discarded at its semicolon; later color:red is retained as normal importance typed opaque red. The bounded declaration parser hits its semicolon boundary before finding a colon; basic EndOfInput is preserved as UnexpectedEnd at byte3.
